answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a sable-denominated bond to register, and every epoch a random gale of peer audits samples identities. A sybil cluster must bond every fake identity, so multiplying accounts multiplies locked capital, and a failed audit slashes the whole cluster. Honest agents tend their reputation garden while attackers burn real value per clone, making mass identity creation economically irrational.
